data.title: Meduza: Russia is wearing down Kyiv’s air defenses with near-daily drone attacks. Now the strikes continue into daylight.
data.summary: Russia has changed how it attacks Kyiv. It now uses jet-powered drones to strike the Ukrainian capital and other cities. These drones are faster than conventional models and harder to shoot down. The attacks have also become more frequent: Russia launches drones at night and in waves throughout the day, wearing down air defenses and bringing normal life in Kyiv to a standstill. The new tactics became apparent in late August, when Kyiv came under continuous attack for five days. The intensity then eased slightly, but attacks intensified again over the past week: daily strikes from September 22 to 28 killed 13 Kyiv residents and injured more than 160. Overall, Kyiv suffered civilian casualties on 16 of September’s first 24 days — something that had never happened since Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine began.
